$description: ChartFrame and the chart marks (platform/charts, library wave 7, lane C: the chart foundations): their component tokens. Marks take their colors from the data-viz scales (--plx-sys-dataviz-*, through data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

chart-gap.$description: Chart: the space between the caption, the plot and the data grid.

chart-caption-gap.$description: Chart: the space between the title and the description.

chart-description-text.$description: Chart: the description (the chart's takeaway), secondary text.

chart-plot-height-sm.$description: Chart: the plot's height at size sm (a sparkline-sized chart in a card).

chart-plot-height-md.$description: Chart: the plot's height at size md (the default).

chart-plot-height-lg.$description: Chart: the plot's height at size lg (a chart that is the page's subject).

chart-margin-block-start.$description: Chart: the room above the plot area, so the top tick label is not cut.

chart-margin-inline-end.$description: Chart: the room after the plot area.

chart-margin-block-end.$description: Chart: the room under the plot area for the category or time axis labels.

chart-margin-inline-start.$description: Chart: the room before the plot area for the value axis labels.

chart-mark-default-color.$description: Chart: the color of a mark without data-plx-dataviz (the first categorical color).

chart-line-width.$description: Chart: the stroke of a line series.

chart-point-outline.$description: Chart: the ring around a point, so points stay apart where they overlap a line or each other.

chart-point-outline-width.$description: Chart: the width of the ring around a point.

chart-axis-line-color.$description: Chart: the axis line (the baseline at zero or the plot's edge).

chart-grid-line-color.$description: Chart: a grid line behind the marks.

chart-tick-label-text.$description: Chart: a tick label (a value, a date, a category).

chart-tick-label-font-family.$description: Chart: tick labels are technical values: the data font (Reddit Mono).
